summary.intent: Monitor PR #349 for automated bot reviews (CodeRabbit, Copilot), auto-resolve them as they arrive, then collect staging performance baselines for the vault login path, and fix a session restore race condition that was breaking E2E tests.
summary.outcome: All 23 review threads on PR #349 resolved across 4 rounds with real bug fixes committed; staging perf baselines captured and documented; session restore race condition diagnosed, fixed in PR #350, and merged with nitpick cleanup.

repo: The cron/loop skill can be used to poll GitHub for bot review comments every 5 minutes and auto-trigger /resolve-pr-reviews — effective PR automation pattern for this repo.
Web3Auth Core Kit DKG on Sapphire Devnet dominates login time (~9-45s); the repo's own vault-critical path is only ~722ms serial.
Staging DB was wiped so no existing vaults exist there — IPNS resolve returns 404 for all vault lookups on staging.
The E2E test suite uses @johanneskares/wallet-mock with installMockWallet() for secp256k1 ECDSA wallet signing — required for real Web3Auth SIWE flow.
CI runs tests in parallel workers; log correlation requires careful timestamp matching to avoid attributing parallel test output to the wrong test.

The Axios 401 interceptor in packages/api-client/src/instance.ts already deduplicates 401-triggered refreshes via a shared refreshPromise, but direct calls to authApi.refresh() from React effects are NOT covered.
markdownlint runs in CI and enforces formatting rules on .planning/ docs — prettier-formatted .mjs files also linted by CI even if lint-staged skips them locally.
TEE republishes IPNS records every 3 hours, so IPNS record expiry for key blobs is handled without frontend intervention.

code.finding: Broad try/catch around getVault() + all subsequent IPFS operations meant a 404 from fetchFromIpfs (missing CID) would incorrectly trigger vault re-initialization for an existing user. Fixed by giving getVault() its own isolated try/catch.

After PR #349, existing vault login path resolves vault key IPNS name via deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair. If the IPNS record is missing (pre-migration vault), this throws 'Vault key IPNS name not found', session restore catches it, logs out Core Kit, and the user is stuck.

Session restore effect calls authApi.refresh() directly — multiple React effect cycles on page reload fire this concurrently (6 concurrent calls observed in CI). Each successful refresh proceeds to initializeOrLoadVault(), causing concurrent vault init attempts.
Fixed by adding a module-level refreshPromise deduplication variable so concurrent direct calls to authApi.refresh() share a single in-flight Promise.

Fixed by adding a module-level vaultInitPromise deduplication variable wrapping initializeOrLoadVault — concurrent callers share the same Promise, preventing the duplicate key constraint on UQ_folder_ipns_user_ipns.
directRootIpnsName was the vault key IPNS name but was being used as the root folder IPNS name for folder traversal — real bug requiring separate derivation of both IPNS names.
slice() was used where subarray() should be used for zero-copy typed array views — Copilot caught this.
Sequence-0 conflict on IPNS publish during vault init was logging a warning and continuing — changed to return an error to abort, preventing silent partial-init states.
Playwright's native page.on('request'/'response') events are more reliable than injecting fetch monitoring via evaluate() — the injected monitor doesn't survive navigation.

workflow: The /loop skill with CronCreate enables automated PR review monitoring — effective pattern for letting bots review while doing other work.
Outside-diff-range review comments from Copilot/CodeRabbit don't appear as resolvable GraphQL review threads — must be addressed via PR-level comment replies.
1Password SSH agent can become temporarily unavailable to subprocess commits — retrying after a pause usually resolves it.
Playwright MCP sandbox doesn't support Node module imports (dynamic import() fails) — use Bash with a standalone .mjs script for complex browser automation.
Correlating CI logs across parallel test workers requires timestamp matching; the test worker dots (···) in log output indicate a different parallel test.
GSD todos should cover all layers of a root cause (not just the surface symptom) — the auth/refresh race was the root, vault init race was downstream.

friction: GitHub API GraphQL endpoint timed out once during monitoring — required waiting for next cron tick.
Copilot outside-diff-range comments don't surface as unresolved GraphQL review threads, requiring manual URL intervention from user to discover them.
Web3Auth OTP on staging is real (not test-bypassable) — wallet login via injected mock provider required secp256k1 signing not available in Playwright MCP evaluate() context.
Playwright MCP browser_run_code doesn't support Node module imports — had to fall back to a Bash-executed standalone script.
1Password SSH agent was temporarily unavailable during a commit attempt, requiring a retry.
prettier CI check caught formatting issues in staging-perf-wallet.mjs that lint-staged missed locally (lint-staged only checks staged files).
markdownlint enforced formatting rules on .planning/ markdown docs, requiring additional fixup commits.
Staging DB was wiped so no live vault existed for baseline measurement — had to create one via wallet login, but Core Kit DKG took 19-47s making the baseline noisy.
open_items: Post-deploy re-measurement needed: run tests/web-e2e/staging-perf-wallet.mjs against staging after PR #349 deploys to capture real IPNS resolve + IPFS fetch latencies for a live v2 vault blob.
Session restore for existing vaults that pre-date PR #349 (no vault key IPNS record published) will throw 'Vault key IPNS name not found' — a migration or fallback path is needed.
The E2E test 3.7 (Page reload preserves session) was broken by the race condition — verify it passes after PR #350 merges.
Auth/refresh 401 race: even with the direct-call deduplication fixed, the Axios interceptor's 401-triggered refresh and the session restore direct call could still race — worth a follow-up audit.
Consider whether VaultBlobV2 type removal should be reflected in any external API documentation beyond METADATA_SCHEMAS.md.
The staging-perf-wallet.mjs script is in tests/web-e2e/ — decide whether to keep it long-term or move to .planning/perf/ alongside the baseline doc.
